allowed_conclusions: The approved evidence supports a qualifying-heavy funnel snapshot.
The approved evidence supports a low top-of-funnel representation relative to qualifying.
The approved evidence supports governance concern about visibility of replenishment of new leads.
The approved evidence supports governance framing of R2 as aggregate monitoring and coverage review.
forbidden_conclusions: The approved evidence does not support any claim about current live CRM state.
The approved evidence does not support trend certainty across time.
The approved evidence does not support row-level lead interpretation or PII-bearing analysis.
The approved evidence does not support causal claims about why the funnel is concentrated.
The approved evidence does not support operational authorization, sandbox, or write.
open_questions_that_must_remain_open: Whether the concentration in qualifying is stable, improving, or worsening over time.
Whether low inflow of new leads is seasonal, structural, or incidental.
Whether any live CRM surface can ever be anchored without ambiguity in a future approved chain.
Whether any agent-assisted phase can be tolerated under the session-write caveat without violating zero-write-sensitive requirements.
